question: Retrieve distinct case references, case numbers, investigation numbers, and clone information where a single clone simultaneously exhibits all three of the following genetic alterations: (1) a loss on chromosome 13 between positions 48,303,751 and 48,481,890, (2) a loss on chromosome 17 between positions 7,668,421 and 7,687,490, and (3) a gain on chromosome 11 between positions 108,223,067 and 108,369,102. For each matching clone, display the chromosomal details for each of these three regions (including chromosome number represented by ChrOrd, start position, and end position) and the corresponding karyotype short description from the KaryClone table. Use the CytoConverted and KaryClone.
sql:
WITH matches AS (
SELECT cc13.RefNo, cc13.CaseNo, cc13.InvNo, cc13.Clone,
       cc13.Chr AS Chr13, cc13.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd13, cc13.Start AS Start13, cc13.`End` AS End13,
       cc17.Chr AS Chr17, cc17.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd17, cc17.Start AS Start17, cc17.`End` AS End17,
       cc11.Chr AS Chr11, cc11.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd11, cc11.Start AS Start11, cc11.`End` AS End11,
       kc.CloneShort,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc13.RefNo, cc13.CaseNo, cc13.InvNo, cc13.Clone ORDER BY cc13.Start) AS rn13,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc13.RefNo, cc13.CaseNo, cc13.InvNo, cc13.Clone ORDER BY cc17.Start) AS rn17,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc13.RefNo, cc13.CaseNo, cc13.InvNo, cc13.Clone ORDER BY cc11.Start) AS rn11
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc13
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc17 ON cc13.RefNo = cc17.RefNo AND cc13.CaseNo = cc17.CaseNo AND cc13.InvNo = cc17.InvNo AND cc13.Clone = cc17.Clone
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc11 ON cc13.RefNo = cc11.RefNo AND cc13.CaseNo = cc11.CaseNo AND cc13.InvNo = cc11.InvNo AND cc13.Clone = cc11.Clone
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON cc13.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND cc13.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND cc13.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND cc13.Clone = kc.CloneNo
WHERE cc13.Chr = 'chr13' AND cc13.Type = 'Loss' AND cc13.Start < 48481890 AND cc13.`End` > 48303751
  AND cc17.Chr = 'chr17' AND cc17.Type = 'Loss' AND cc17.Start < 7687490 AND cc17.`End` > 7668421
  AND cc11.Chr = 'chr11' AND cc11.Type = 'Gain' AND cc11.Start < 108369102 AND cc11.`End` > 108223067
)
SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn13 = 1 THEN ChrOrd13 END) AS ChrOrd13,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn13 = 1 THEN Start13 END) AS Start13,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn13 = 1 THEN End13 END) AS End13,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn17 = 1 THEN ChrOrd17 END) AS ChrOrd17,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn17 = 1 THEN Start17 END) AS Start17,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn17 = 1 THEN End17 END) AS End17,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn11 = 1 THEN ChrOrd11 END) AS ChrOrd11,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn11 = 1 THEN Start11 END) AS Start11,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn11 = 1 THEN End11 END) AS End11,
       MAX(CloneShort) AS CloneShort
FROM matches
GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
ORDER BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
